title: Comparison of changes in number of hyperreflective dots after intravitreal ranibizumab or dexamethasone implant in patients with branch retinal vein occlusion

groups.agent: dexamethasone implant 700 ug (Ozurdex), PRN every 3 months after the initial implant
groups.description: Group 1: eyes treated with the dexamethasone implant only, from the first injection

groups.agent: ranibizumab 0.5 mg, three monthly injections then PRN
groups.description: Group 2: eyes that received ranibizumab only; eyes with a poor response after three ranibizumab injections were switched to the implant and form group 3

groups.agent: ranibizumab (three monthly injections) then dexamethasone implant PRN
groups.description: Group 3: eyes switched from ranibizumab to the dexamethasone implant after a poor anatomical response to three ranibizumab injections

exclusions.what: Groups 1-3, BCVA (logMAR) at baseline and months 1, 3, 6 and 12 (Table 2, tjo.TJO-D-22-00177-t002!R5C2-C6, R10C2-C6, R15C2-C6)
exclusions.reason: Complete-case set (protocol inclusion 5): the inclusion criterion is a follow-up of at least 12 months, equal to the last tabulated visit (month 12), and the article does not state that no treated eye was left out (retrospective review of the eyes that met the criterion).

Also defined by post-baseline events: eyes with a poor response to three ranibizumab injections were switched to the dexamethasone implant (group 3), so group 2 holds the eyes that were not switched; groups defined after baseline are excluded.

exclusions.what: Baseline BCVA (Table 1, tjo.TJO-D-22-00177-t001!R11) and BCVA at 1 year (Table 3, tjo.TJO-D-22-00177-t003!R4)
exclusions.reason: Baseline-only and single-visit tabulations of the same excluded groups.

notes: BCVA was measured with a Snellen chart and the decimal values were converted to logMAR for the statistical analyses (Methods); Table 2 labels the rows BCVA (logMAR) and the statistic mean +/- SD.
Treatment-naive macular edema due to branch retinal vein occlusion; PRN regimens as described per group.
Central macular thickness and hyperreflective-dot counts are not extracted.
